title: Listing Highlight: 116m Baglietto 116 2000
description: Discover the 2000 Baglietto 116, a masterpiece of Italian yacht design blending classic elegance with modern amenities for discerning international buyers.
html:
A Timeless Superyacht Combining Craftsmanship And Contemporary Design

The 2000 Baglietto 116 represents a pinnacle of Italian maritime craftsmanship, embodying the design philosophy that has made Baglietto one of Europe’s most respected yacht builders. This 116-meter superyacht stands as a testament to the enduring appeal of vessels that prioritize both aesthetic refinement and functional excellence. For buyers seeking a vessel with proven heritage and timeless design credentials, this Baglietto offers an exceptional opportunity to acquire a yacht that has been meticulously maintained and thoughtfully updated over its operational history.

Baglietto’s reputation in the superyacht industry spans generations, with the Italian shipyard known for producing vessels that command respect in the world’s most exclusive anchorages. The 116-meter platform provides substantial interior volume while maintaining the sleek proportions that define modern superyacht aesthetics. This particular vessel exemplifies the builder’s commitment to quality construction and attention to detail that characterizes every Baglietto that leaves the Varazze shipyard. The yacht’s design reflects the sensibilities of early 2000s superyacht architecture, a period when builders were beginning to integrate contemporary comfort standards with classical design elements. The exterior profile of the 2000 Baglietto 116 demonstrates the careful balance between visual drama and practical functionality. The vessel’s lines flow seamlessly from bow to stern, with generous deck spaces designed for entertaining and relaxation. The superstructure incorporates multiple levels of outdoor living areas, each thoughtfully positioned to maximize views while providing shelter from the elements. The yacht’s beam and draft have been optimized to ensure both stability in varied sea conditions and the ability to access shallow-water destinations throughout the Mediterranean and beyond.

Interior accommodations aboard this Baglietto reflect the standards expected of a superyacht of this caliber. The layout provides generous owner’s quarters, multiple guest suites, and crew accommodations that allow for extended cruising with full support staff. The main saloon and dining areas showcase the refined aesthetic that characterizes Italian yacht design, with attention paid to natural light, spatial flow, and the integration of high-quality furnishings and finishes. The yacht’s galley facilities support sophisticated culinary operations, while the crew areas ensure that service standards can be maintained throughout extended voyages. The technical specifications of the 2000 Baglietto 116 reflect the engineering standards of its era, with propulsion systems and mechanical systems designed for reliability and efficiency. The yacht’s fuel capacity and range capabilities make it suitable for extended cruising throughout the Mediterranean, Atlantic, and beyond. The vessel’s stabilization systems and navigation equipment have been updated to current standards, ensuring that the yacht meets contemporary expectations for comfort and safety. The electrical and freshwater systems have been designed with redundancy and efficiency in mind, supporting the operational requirements of a vessel of this size.

For Miami-based buyers and international clientele seeking entry into the superyacht market, the 2000 Baglietto 116 presents a compelling proposition. The vessel’s proven design and construction quality reduce the uncertainties often associated with older superyachts, while its size and capabilities position it within the range of serious collectors and experienced operators. The yacht’s Italian heritage carries significant prestige in international waters, and its presence in any owner’s fleet signals an appreciation for maritime craftsmanship and design excellence. FYI Yachts recognizes the particular appeal of Baglietto vessels to discerning clients who value heritage, quality, and the enduring elegance that characterizes the finest European yacht builders.

The market for well-maintained superyachts of this caliber remains robust, particularly among buyers who understand the value of established builders and proven designs. The 2000 Baglietto 116 represents an opportunity to acquire a vessel with significant operational history, documented maintenance records, and the kind of design pedigree that transcends trends. Whether intended for personal use, charter operations, or as a flagship for an international fleet, this superyacht offers the kind of versatility and quality that justifies serious consideration. The vessel’s position in the current market reflects both its inherent value and the ongoing demand for superyachts that combine Italian design sensibility with the practical requirements of modern maritime operations. Prospective buyers should recognize that a superyacht of this vintage and caliber represents not merely a purchase but an investment in maritime heritage. The 2000 Baglietto 116 carries with it the legacy of one of Europe’s most distinguished shipyards, combined with the practical advantages of a vessel that has been refined through years of operational experience. For those seeking to join the international community of superyacht owners, this Baglietto offers an entry point that does not compromise on quality, design, or the kind of prestige that comes with owning a vessel built by true masters of the craft.
